name: Isometric City
desc: A breathing dusk metropolis of seeded isometric towers that scrolls endlessly past the camera, windows twinkling on and off while traffic light-streaks race the streets, blimp-clouds drift, and a sun-moon sweeps a slow day-night arc across a blue-violet skyline.

energy.doc: fraction of windows lit + glow amplitude

style.doc: render philosophy: dusk-neon / night-cyber / cyan wireframe schematic / warm sunset silhouette / grayscale ink

act.doc: dramaturgy: steady breathing city / fast day-night timelapse / dark sparse blackout
